ValidationRule.description: Covers the "Address" module of the Lead-to-Cash automation suite. Salesforce has no standalone Address object in standard Sales Cloud - addresses live as compound fields on Account (Billing/Shipping) and Contact (Mailing/Other). This rule validates the US postal code format on Account's Billing Address as the representative example; replicate the pattern (with the right regex per country) for Shipping Address and for Contact's address fields if your org needs it.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid postal code format. US postal codes must match 12345 or 12345-6789.
